tharokh.floor: dark umber bedrock flagstones from an earth dragon's root-choked caverns: fine roots and dark moss threading through the cracks and along the bevel, a little loose soil, earthy brown with muted moss-green accents
tharokh.pillar: rough-hewn dark bedrock blocks gripped by thick gnarled roots that wrap the shaft, a cap of packed earth and moss with a few small ferns (kept low, within the cap outline)
tharokh.light: an iron wall bracket holding a cluster of glowing amber cave fungus caps (warm amber-gold light), small spores drifting

vyraketh.floor: black basalt flagstones from a fire dragon's forge-throne: thin glowing ember-orange fissures in a few cracks (subtle, not lava), soot and ash dusting along the bevel, charcoal-black with warm red-orange highlights
vyraketh.pillar: black basalt and obsidian blocks with faint glowing ember cracks between them, a charred and scorched cap with a thin lip of cooled lava
vyraketh.light: an iron wall bracket holding a small iron brazier bowl with a bright flame (orange-red fire, a few sparks)

vaeloryx.floor: weathered mid-grey limestone flagstones from an air dragon's ruined sky-temple: cool grey stone at MID value (clearly darker than white, similar overall brightness to ordinary dungeon stone), edges rounded by wind, faint drifts of pale sand in the cracks, a slight cool blue-grey cast
vaeloryx.pillar: weathered limestone blocks in a warm sand-grey at MID value (matching an ordinary dungeon stone's brightness, not white), edges rounded and pitted by centuries of wind, a few long horizontal wind-scoured grooves and fine sand caught in the joints; the cap worn smooth and slightly sloped. No cloth, no ribbons, no banners, no ornaments, nothing tied to it
vaeloryx.light: an iron wall bracket holding a small glass wind-lantern with a pale gold flame, tilted slightly as if by a breeze

iskaldra.floor: frost-rimed dark blue-grey slate flagstones from an ice dragon's frozen hall: a thin crust of hoarfrost along the bevel and cracks and a few fine ice veins; DARK and desaturated (mostly deep slate with only a cold blue tint), calm interior
iskaldra.pillar: dark blue-grey slate blocks crusted with frost, the cap covered in a thick lip of clear blue ice with a few short icicles
iskaldra.light: an iron wall bracket holding a jagged crystal of glowing pale-blue ice

zekarion.floor: dark storm-slate flagstones from a lightning dragon's tempest spire: thin tarnished copper inlay lines running along the bevel and one crack, a little verdigris, cold blue-grey with a faint violet cast
zekarion.pillar: dark slate blocks bound by tarnished copper bands with verdigris, a cap with a short copper lightning-rod spike in its centre (kept short, within 12% above the cap)
zekarion.light: a copper wall sconce holding a small iron cage with a crackling violet-white spark of lightning inside

noctyrax.floor: polished black marble flagstones from the heart of the Umbra: faint violet veins, a soft cold sheen, a few hairline cracks leaking a dim violet glow; very dark, calm interior
noctyrax.pillar: black marble blocks with thin tarnished silver filigree and violet veins, a cracked cap leaking faint violet light
noctyrax.light: an iron wall bracket holding a black candle burning with a dark violet flame (umbral fire, violet-white core)
